decision.reason: The privileged demonstration made every final answer available, but no rollout completed the measured natural request-response-result chain. Action inspection showed coordinator file access before delegation, polling and child-session inspection after successful spawn, and repeated post-message tool work. Correct answers therefore cannot be treated as evidence of a clean coordination policy.
decision.next: Teach only the first ownership/spawn/yield decision with an opt-in thinking rationale, then collect fresh natural thinking trajectories. Admit complete trajectories only after the model executes the causal chain without coordinator path access, polling, repeated cells, or demonstration leakage.
